title: Closed-form depth-fusion readout versus parameter-efficient adaptation of speech foundation models for low-resource clinical screening from voice: analysis code and aggregate data
description: Post-training reconstruction of the article analysis from 2,025 run-level aggregate results. Includes locked Python environment, original analysis generators, aggregate CSV/JSON inputs, scientific regression checks and HTML-to-PDF figures. Does not include audio, participant records, individual predictions or model training code. Code: MIT; aggregate data: CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA. This candidate is prepared for review and is not a published deposition. The default profile reconstructs the active manuscript from run-level exports without archived q values. Historical exploratory tables are inactive and outside its validation scope.
